---
title: "Sensitivity of the headline results to the run exclusions"
---

Reruns the whole analysis twice: once with the paper's exclusions, and once
keeping every run with a recorded age (see `helper/filter_runs.R`). Each run
executes 02, 03 and 04 and then the paper's own code, so the sensitivity
results come from exactly the analysis the paper reports, not a copy of it.

Each run happens in a fresh temporary directory holding a copy of `data/` and
`helper/`, so nothing in the project is touched apart from the output,
`models/mrot_exclusion_sensitivity.rds`. The "main" row must reproduce the
paper; `mrot_paper.qmd` checks this when it renders.

Takes about 15 minutes, most of it the prior sweep in 03.

```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(parallel)
```

```{r}
# The paper's code, with its Quarto includes expanded so it runs as one script.
paper_code <- function() {
  dir <- here("mrot_paper")
  qmd <- read_file(file.path(dir, "mrot_paper.qmd")) |>
    str_remove_all(regex("<!--.*?-->", dotall = TRUE)) |>
    str_replace_all("\\{\\{< include (\\S+) >\\}\\}",
                    \(m) map_chr(str_match(m, "include (\\S+)")[, 2],
                                 \(f) read_file(file.path(dir, f))))
  qmd_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".qmd")
  write_file(qmd, qmd_file)
  r_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".R")
  knitr::purl(qmd_file, output = r_file, quiet = TRUE)
  read_lines(r_file)
}

# Appended to the paper's code: collect the headline results it computed.
extract_code <- '
p_num <- \\(s) if (is.numeric(s)) s else if (grepl("<", s)) 0.0005 else as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.]", "", s))
age <- ability_sex_comp("age", "+1")
sex <- ability_sex_comp("sex", "Male - Female")
ang <- slope("mrot")
rts <- rt_sex_comp("mrot")
best <- mod_tbl |> filter(d_BIC == 0)
headline <- tibble(
  exclusions      = Sys.getenv("MROT_EXCLUSIONS"),
  n_children      = n_final$n_users,
  n_runs          = n_final$n_runs,
  best_model      = paste(best$itemtype, best$invariance),
  dbic_configural = delta_bic_configural,
  age_str         = slope_str(age),
  age_p           = p_num(age$p.value),
  sex_str         = slope_str(sex),
  sex_p           = p_num(sex$p.value),
  sex_sd          = ability_sex_ci$estimate[1],
  sex_sd_lo       = ability_sex_ci$conf.low[1],
  sex_sd_hi       = ability_sex_ci$conf.high[1],
  age_sex_p       = p_num(ability_slope_diffs$p.value[1]),
  sex_site_chisq  = ability_sex_site_lrt$chisq,
  sex_site_df     = ability_sex_site_lrt$df,
  sex_site_p      = ability_sex_site_lrt$p.value,
  angle_str       = slope_str(ang),
  angle_pct       = as.character(ang$interpretation),
  angle_p         = p_num(ang$p.value),
  rt_sex_str      = slope_str(rts),
  rt_sex_pct      = as.character(rts$interpretation),
  rt_sex_p        = p_num(rts$p.value)
)
saveRDS(headline, "headline.rds")
'
```

```{r}
run_scenario <- function(exclusions, paper) {
  dir <- file.path(tempdir(), paste0("mrot_", exclusions))
  dir.create(file.path(dir, "models"), recursive = TRUE)
  file.create(file.path(dir, ".here"))  # makes here() resolve to this directory
  file.copy(here("data"), dir, recursive = TRUE)
  file.copy(here("helper"), dir, recursive = TRUE)
  for (nb in c("02_fit_irt", "03_prior_sensitivity", "04_reliability")) {
    knitr::purl(here(paste0(nb, ".qmd")), output = file.path(dir, paste0(nb, ".R")),
                quiet = TRUE)
  }
  write_lines(c(paper, extract_code), file.path(dir, "paper.R"))

  for (s in c("02_fit_irt", "03_prior_sensitivity", "04_reliability", "paper")) {
    cmd <- sprintf("cd %s && MROT_EXCLUSIONS=%s R_LIBS=%s Rscript %s.R > %s.log 2>&1",
                   shQuote(dir), exclusions, shQuote(paste(.libPaths(), collapse = ":")),
                   s, s)
    if (system(cmd) != 0) {
      stop(exclusions, ": ", s, " failed\n",
           paste(tail(read_lines(file.path(dir, paste0(s, ".log"))), 20), collapse = "\n"))
    }
  }
  read_rds(file.path(dir, "headline.rds"))
}
```

```{r}
paper <- paper_code()
results <- mclapply(c("main", "relaxed"), run_scenario, paper = paper, mc.cores = 2)
failed <- map_lgl(results, \(r) inherits(r, "try-error"))
if (any(failed)) stop(results[failed][[1]])

exclusion_sensitivity <- list_rbind(results)
write_rds(exclusion_sensitivity, here("models/mrot_exclusion_sensitivity.rds"))
print(as.data.frame(t(exclusion_sensitivity)))
```
